effects: The signer sends `amount` of the vault collateral (LBTC, 0x8236…4494) to the vault through transferFrom, which spends the signer's LBTC allowance to the vault.
The vault credits newly minted active shares to `onBehalfOf`, not necessarily to the signer.
formats.shown: Deposit of the amount in LBTC into the named vault, with the beneficiary address that receives the vault position.

effects: The vault burns the signer's active shares, enough to cover `amount` LBTC at the current share price.
The vault moves `amount` LBTC from active stake into the next epoch's withdrawal pool. The vault credits that withdrawal claim to `claimer`, who can claim it after the epoch ends.
No tokens move in this call.
formats.shown: A withdrawal request for the amount in LBTC, with the claim owner who can collect it later.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many vault shares the signer burns; the share price is in storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake());` Shares come from storage, not calldata. The descriptor shows only `#.amount` 'Requested assets'.

findings.title: withdraw shows the requested LBTC, but slashing before the claim can reduce what the claimer receives.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol onSlash: `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1] = nextWithdrawals - nextWithdrawalsSlashed;` This reduces the pool the claim is paid from. The descriptor shows 'Requested assets'.

effects: The vault burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
The vault converts the shares to LBTC at the current share price and queues that LBTC as a withdrawal claim for `claimer` in the next epoch.
No tokens move in this call.
formats.shown: Queues a raw share count for withdrawal and names the claim owner. It does not show the LBTC value.

findings.title: redeem shows shares as a raw integer, so the signer cannot see the LBTC value queued.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares());`. The descriptor field `#.shares` has format 'raw', and case 6 shows 'Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares'. Vault V1 shares are not an ERC-20 token, so no tokenAmount format applies.

effects: The vault marks the signer's withdrawal claim for `epoch` as used.
The vault sends the signer's whole LBTC withdrawal for that epoch to `recipient`. The amount comes from storage.
formats.shown: Claims the withdrawal of a raw epoch number to the recipient address. No asset or amount is shown.

findings.title: claim intent and fields never name LBTC, the asset sent to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. The descriptor intent is 'Claim withdrawal', and the interpolatedIntent is 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'. No field names the token.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Claim LBTC withdrawal" and the interpolatedIntent to "Claim LBTC of epoch {epoch} to {recipient}".

findings.title: claim cannot show the LBTC amount because the vault reads it from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault._claim: `amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender);`. The amount is not in the calldata.

effects: The vault marks the signer's withdrawal claims for every listed epoch as used.
The vault sends the sum of the signer's LBTC withdrawals for those epochs to `recipient`. The amount comes from storage.
formats.shown: Claims withdrawals for the listed epochs to the recipient address. No asset or amount is shown.

findings.title: claimBatch intent and fields never name LBTC, the asset sent to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. The descriptor intent is 'Claim withdrawals', and the interpolatedIntent is 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Claim LBTC withdrawals" and the interpolatedIntent to "Claim LBTC of epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}".

findings.title: claimBatch cannot show the total LBTC amount because the vault reads it from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i]);`, where `_claim` reads `withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)` from storage.
